analysis: The Prime Minister's Independence Day address said the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act benefited about 4 crore families in 2008-09. Ministry of Rural Development figures put the number at 4.49-4.51 crore households, with 216 crore persondays generated. The stated figure is therefore consistent with the official data.
